note: Each entry is ONE anchored record: line 0 carries the `[ISO Z] [sid] ` anchor, the rest are continuation lines with no anchor. `sid` and `days` are substituted at generation time. The multi-line record exists to separate a RECORD count from a LINE count: 4 of its continuation lines start with `gh pr view`, so a line-based widening counter reports 5 where the true answer is 1.
